model.costScope: Single full-recipient boundary C*f+K. C includes all recorded support functions and settlement. K is unknown unrecognized donated/volunteer inputs needed by the same portfolio, net of recorded overlap. Displayed finite illustration conditionally K=0. Not complete economic cost or marginal gift price; induced external healthcare cost remains unpriced.
model.geographicAttribution: Chicago/Cicero/Harvey sites establish MSA eligibility, not 95% residency. Staff describe statewide activity. g=.95 is judgment, tested at .75; national training receives no benefit credit.
model.formula: deaths=N*c*r*h*e*a*b; L=sum(t=0..T-1)(s^t*u/(1+d)^(t+.5)); Q_all=deaths*L+H; Q_MSA=g*Q_all; cost=C*f+K; price10=10*cost/Q_MSA only when Q_MSA>0.
model.counterfactual: EMS, peers, libraries, other outreach and donors continue. a selects reach lacking equivalent timely rescue without CRA; h is counterfactual fatal risk in that selected group, not population mortality. e is conditional prevention in that group. b is additional usable capacity beyond replacement finance. These unmeasured factors may be correlated and are not trial-calibrated.
model.attribution: Whole recipient only; no credit for city decline or all reversals. Other portfolio health H is signed and unknown. Cross-recipient benefits overlap and cannot be added.
model.uncertainty: Very low confidence. Central retains alpha assumptions for continuity, not calibrated expected value. K=0 and H=0 are conditional omissions, not established absence or lower bounds. Marginal donor price is unknown. Scenario ranges are not confidence intervals.
model.nativeOutcomes: Conditional deaths prevented over one operating year, at most five subsequent survival years centrally, ten in favorable sensitivity; no perpetual cohort or separate infection/reversal credit.

inputs.name: C
inputs.rationale: All 2024 audited expense including settlement loss; later audit preferred to unreconciled earlier return.

inputs.name: f
inputs.rationale: Keeps full historicalcost while reducing output for cuts; cost growth tested separately.

inputs.name: N
inputs.unit: annual reported people relying on services
inputs.rationale: Translates source statement of over 15,000 annual reliance into model population; current distinct reach unverified and halved in sensitivity.

inputs.name: c
inputs.rationale: 40%reduction for staff/services; actual current volume unknown.

inputs.name: h
inputs.rationale: Uncalibrated 2% fatal risk in people without equivalent timely rescue; external Ontario post-poisoning cohort is context, not CRA calibration.

inputs.name: e
inputs.rationale: Assumed 15% conditional mortality reduction before the separate alternative-rescue factor; no recipient trial supports this number. The HEALing Communities trial tested a broader community package and is not a direct test of CRA or naloxone alone.

inputs.name: a
inputs.rationale: Judged share without equivalent timely alternative rescue, not local deduplicated evidence.

inputs.name: b
inputs.rationale: Illustrative capacity response, not priced donor tranche; grants/reserves may substitute for a gift. Zero response tested.

inputs.name: T
inputs.rationale: Hard cap5years, not remaining life expectancy.

inputs.name: s
inputs.rationale: Judged survival allowing repeat overdose/comorbidity; not fitted or proven conservative.

inputs.name: u
inputs.rationale: Accounts for chronic illness and substance-use burden; not age-dependent valuation.

inputs.name: g
inputs.unit: Chicago MSA share of modeled health
inputs.rationale: Current service anchors inMSA; unknown resident/training leakage.

inputs.name: K
inputs.rationale: Net-of-overlap opportunity cost of donated inputs/volunteers. Conditional zero; 25% and 100% expense add-ons not measured valuations.

inputs.name: H
inputs.rationale: Unknown infection, counseling/referral, displacement and adverse effects. Conditional zero; positive/negative stress tests are not occurrence claims.

sensitivity: Sixteen cases include zero clinical effect, zero finance, no alternative-access gap and net-negative health; nonpositive QALYs have no finite price.
Settlement exclusion and descriptive historical mean do not establish recurring budgets. Additional resources can exceed illustrative 25%/100% sensitivities.
Distinct reach, hazard, horizon and geography materially affect results; favorable/poor cases are not probability bounds.
Correlated a,b,c,h,e point judgments do not quantify posterior uncertainty.
Cross-organization estimates cannot be summed; alternative-service factors do not establish deduplication.
missingInputs: 2025/2026 accounts, cash/restrictions, 2024 audit/return bridge, settlement payment status, controls and audit inconsistencies.
Grant conditions, renewals and reimbursement periods; payment date is not current-year revenue or donor room.
Priced unfunded whole-recipient restoration tranche, hiring timing/output and financing substitution.
Distinct opioid-risk reach, kit use, verified outcomes, alternative supply and MSA residence.
Donated supplies and volunteer opportunity cost net of recognized and supplier overlap.
Recipient causal mortality effect, repeat-event survival, utility and signed other-portfolio net health.
